quality.notes: Three cells aged to 70% (300k km), 40% (206k km) and 15% (95k km) SOH. One partial download marker (Data Summary.tab.part) is present. Cell spec from A123's official ANR26650M1-B datasheet. voltage_min_V left unset: this document does not state a discharge cutoff voltage explicitly (only charge parameters and discharge current limits); other sources commonly cite 2.0V for this cell family but that was not independently confirmed here. Charge/discharge rate estimates, where explicitly marked raw_data in the citations, use signed observed current extrema divided by the stored nominal Ah. These are measurement estimates over the cached extraction scope, not imposed CC protocol setpoints; they may include pulse, dynamic, regenerative or diagnostic segments and measurement excursions. Current units and direction were checked against the cited original headers, status labels or separate charge/discharge counters. cached ranges cover all parsed CSV parts of three cells; the maximum charge value was independently located in one HPPC CSV. The charge maximum is an HPPC pulse, so it does not describe a sustained recharge rate. Both observed directional maxima now use cached global current extrema: 8.00052C charge in an HPPC pulse, and 19.2004C discharge in a WLTP segment. The global -48.001 A was independently located in 2-95k km case.zip::95k km case/Cycle 0/951_WLTP_90a.csv line 506, with Current [A] and sign checked against DCH/CHA rows. The 1C value remains the reference-discharge protocol; 15.00176C is only a separately traced HPPC subset peak. The extracted cycle total counts per-file tester cycles across diagnostic and aging parts; it is not the independently reconciled WLTP aging-folder count. Charging profile: the three cells run different power profiles (95k, 206k and 300k km cases) but all are time-varying; the HEV profile charges only through regenerative bursts. The paper (Anselma et al., Applied Energy 285 (2021) 116440; full text read) confirms the cell: A123 ANR26650M1-B, 2.5 Ah rated, 26650 LiFePO4 (the readme's "2p5Ah" is not a model name). Three cells were aged, one per current profile ('95k', '206k', '300k' km lifetime cases, packs of 140, 240 and 240 cells at 1.06, 1.82 and 1.82 kWh; RMS current 10.36, 7.31 and 6.19 A; planned maximum charging current about 20 A, maximum discharge 45.9, 44.2 and 25.6 A), in a 25 C chamber (measured cell surface temperatures during ageing about 27.6, 26.8 and 26.6 C) with a Digatron MCT 75-0/5-8ME cycler and a temperature sensor on the front centre face of each cell. The discharge cut-off of the 1C capacity test is 2.5 V and the charge limit 3.6 V. Each block is characterisation (HPPC 10 s 1C pulses, two 1C capacity discharges), discharge to 50% SOC of the measured capacity, and 300 WLTP cycles (15 x 20); the paper stopped at 80% SOH, while the 95k and 206k cells were kept running further. The charging current limit of 20 A stops the cell reaching 3.6 V, so the 20 A charge (8C) is a profile limit, as the observed 8C extremum here shows; the observed -48 A discharge (19.2C) exceeds the planned 45.9 A maximum.
